name: Controlled Live Test Preparation
execution_rule: Run one clear live test at a time only after explicit owner approval.
stop_rule: If a live test fails, stop, capture evidence, add or update an eval, fix, rerun regressions, then retest that item only.
token_rule: Known/common flows must remain deterministic/local-first; AI/OpenAI use is not expected for the prepared live checklist except future photo/invoice extraction if explicitly approved in that later live test.

tests.title: WhatsApp deterministic sale
tests.action: Send a clear known sale such as panadol2cash.
tests.expected: Reply logs a sale locally with sale number, price total, stock reduction, and no AI fallback.

tests.title: Typo sale
tests.expected: Reply resolves Panadol x1 Cash locally and logs sale safely.

tests.title: Shorthand sale
tests.action: Send a known shorthand sale such as amox1mpesa.
tests.expected: Reply resolves medicine, quantity, and M-Pesa locally.

tests.title: Ambiguous medicine
tests.expected: Reply asks one short clarification instead of guessing.

tests.title: No-stock block
tests.action: Send ors 9 when ORS stock is zero.
tests.expected: Sale is blocked, missed demand is saved, and stock is not reduced below zero.

tests.title: Stock check
tests.expected: Reply returns current stock without writing a sale log.

tests.title: Undo by sale number
tests.action: After a test sale, send undo sale N.
tests.expected: Sale is marked undone once, stock is restored once, and reversal audit is kept.

tests.title: Correction by sale number
tests.action: After a test sale, send correct sale N to mpesa or correct sale N quantity 1.
tests.expected: Ledger correction updates payment or quantity, reconciles stock/finance, and keeps audit trace.

tests.title: Report today
tests.action: Send report today or trigger daily report endpoint with live date.
tests.expected: Report reflects active ledger totals after undo/correction and includes payment reconciliation.

tests.title: Multi-owner/staff simulated
tests.action: Run staff sale, staff pending correction, owner approval, and owner reversal using actor context.
tests.expected: Staff/owner audit is preserved and pharmacy namespace remains isolated.

tests.title: Offline Tap & Talk online
tests.action: Open offline app while online and speak a clear known medicine.
tests.expected: Editable Sale Ready card opens from first clear attempt where browser speech permits.

tests.title: Offline Tap & Talk offline
tests.action: Open cached offline app offline and speak or enter a clear known medicine.
tests.expected: Local/offline path queues or opens sale card without API dependency where device capability allows.

tests.title: Offline media queue online/offline
tests.action: Queue a media/intake item offline, reconnect, and observe sync behavior.
tests.expected: Queue preserves item, syncs once, and avoids duplicates.

tests.title: WhatsApp invoice/photo
tests.action: Send a controlled invoice/photo sample only when photo testing is explicitly resumed.
tests.expected: Photo path captures evidence for later polish without breaking deterministic sale flows.

tests.title: Offline invoice/photo
tests.action: Capture or queue a controlled invoice/photo sample in offline app when photo testing is resumed.
tests.expected: Offline photo queue preserves evidence and sync path without duplicate processing.

tests.title: Editable approval card
tests.action: Open a prepared sale or extracted item and edit quantity/payment before approval.
tests.expected: Edit is visible before submit, saved once, and audit remains clear.

tests.title: Token usage preserved
tests.action: Observe logs/metrics during known deterministic live checks.
tests.expected: Known commands show no OpenAI/API calls; any approved photo extraction is explicitly noted.
